title: Parrot's Questlog
description: A revamp of the Questlog mod's textures to give it a more rustic and medieval feeling, as well as adding some custom quest pages for further customization themed around both vanilla and Create
body:
## Parrot's Questlog

![Questlog Main Page](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/0d015c4ca44c70d53bf4b27e71520791da71ef13.png)

This resource pack is meant to serve as a revamp of the [Questlog](https://modrinth.com/mod/questlog) mod to give it a more rustic feeling. Specifically, it adds more textured quest pages, tabs, buttons, etc. It also has a set of custom quest pages for you to use as quest backgrounds.

A full list of the custom quest pages is below (and some in the gallery)! 

I've also noted the locations of each texture file so that you can more easily set up your quests to use them. (see how on the [Questlog Wiki](https://moddedmc.wiki/en/project/questlog/latest/docs) specifically on the Quest Definition Page, look for background_texture)
